profile.primary_concern: concerns about medication interactions due to multiple sclerosis treatment

context: As a woman living with multiple sclerosis, you may experience feelings of anxiety when considering PrEP. Your condition requires careful management of medications, and you are worried about potential interactions and the implications for your overall health. This has led to a sense of uncertainty and fear regarding the safety of starting PrEP, despite your desire to take control of your sexual health.
